info.name: VelChat — Backend API
info.description: VelChat backend (WhatsApp + Teams + Slack hybrid). Each request targets a per-service base-URL variable (authUrl, chatUrl, groupChannelUrl, ...). Import an environment: **VelChat — Local** points every URL at the dev gateway http://localhost:8080 (run `pnpm start:all`), **VelChat — Production** points each at its Render URL. Set {{accessToken}} after login for the authenticated routes; {{tenant}} for tenant-scoped ones.

item.name: Auth (§B2)
item.description: DAPT auth: Reverse-OTP cold start, device-key + passkey login, rotating refresh, recovery.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const d = j.data ?? j; if (d.sessionId) pm.collectionVariables.set('sessionId', d.sessionId); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const d = j.data ?? j; if (d.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); } catch (e) {}
try { const j = pm.response.json(); const d = j.data ?? j; if (d.conversationId) pm.collectionVariables.set('conversationId', d.conversationId); } catch (e) {}

item.name: Realtime (§B9) — WebSocket
item.description: Connect a Postman WebSocket request to {{realtimeUrl}}/ws?token=<accessToken> (use wss:// for production). Inbound frames: ping, sync, delivered, read, skdm, skdm-request. Server pushes message / receipt / skdm frames.
